description.content: Search and filter the entire article database with comprehensive filtering options including search, categories, language, country, domain, and date range.

query.description: Search query with advanced operators. Supports + (AND), | (OR), - (NOT), "..." (phrase), * (prefix), () (grouping), \ (escape). URL-encode when using special characters.
Comma-separated list of fields to search. Options: title, description, keywords, main_text.
Comma-separated country codes to filter articles by locale (e.g., us,ca,gb). Supports 50+ countries.
Comma-separated list of categories to include. Options: general, science, sports, business, health, entertainment, tech, politics, food, travel.
Comma-separated list of categories to exclude.
Comma-separated list of source domains to include (e.g., techcrunch.com,bbc.com).
Comma-separated list of source domains to exclude.
Comma-separated list of source IDs to include (as returned by the /news/sources endpoint).
Comma-separated list of source IDs to exclude.
Comma-separated language codes to filter results (e.g., en,es,fr). Supports 35+ languages.
Return articles published before this date/time (UTC). Formats: Y-m-d\TH:i:s, Y-m-d\TH:i, Y-m-d\TH, Y-m-d, Y-m, Y.
Return articles published after this date/time (UTC). Formats: Y-m-d\TH:i:s, Y-m-d\TH:i, Y-m-d\TH, Y-m-d, Y-m, Y.
Return articles published on this exact date (UTC). Format: Y-m-d.
Sort order for results. Options: published_on (chronological), relevance_score (by search relevance).
Maximum number of results to return per page. Upper bound is determined by the current plan.
Page number for pagination. Maximum total of 20,000 results across all pages.
